edits.before: Trade autos behind the roar sustain — the cow chips politely until level 2 changes religions.
edits.after: Pyke's level-1 hook range and lethality threaten more than your not-yet-online engage.

edits.before: W-Q online — the combo is live and every squishy support is now flash-range nervous.
edits.after: His Q-plus-E all-in lands before your W-Q combo is live — respect hook range.

edits.before: Unbreakable Will online — tower dives become appointments; the cow ignores the counter-CC.
edits.after: Death From Below resets on a kill — commit your knockup only when your ADC can follow.

edits.before: First item: the front line holds and the combos chain into jungler arrivals.
edits.after: His hook lethality still threatens your ADC through frontline — peel, don't dive.

edits.before: Late Alistar opens and survives: combo the carry, ult the focus, and trample the cleanup.
edits.after: Late Alistar takes over: durability and chain-CC win grouped fights as his picks fall off.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: His hook lands as a channel — CC him mid-cast with Trample or your combo cancels it outright.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Committing after his Bone Skewer whiffs, not before — a spent hook is a free fifteen seconds.

edits.before: - Pyke Bone Skewer: matchup-defining — The hook starts the chain — his R cleans what it catches. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Unbreakable Will banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Pyke Bone Skewer: 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s cooldown, matchup-defining — the hook starts the chain, his R cleans what it catches. - Keep R Unbreakable Will banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
